online_feedback: Paid bool>=4 predicted severe pixels only; evaluator pixel union includes even1..3 pixels. No true reference counts or masks enter planner.
policy_definition: Random follows fixed random ranks. Change survey uses coarse75percentile absoluteRGB change. Negative gate compares raw change for unseen cells vs raw change/cost for paid blurred-negative cells; no positive upgrade. No target-calibrated threshold or count utility.
primary_domain: All512x512 published pixels, union across acquired predictions without duplicate counting.
quality_assignment: Frozen SHA256(seed|sample_id|cell_id|survey_quality) parity, known only after paid observation.
random_exact_reference: Also compute evaluator-only expected survey area budget/16 times full fixed-quality survey area; cell supports do not overlap. Keep10-order empirical traces and never supply expectation to planner.
sensitivity_domain: Both RGB dates have at least1 nonzero channel, evaluator-only diagnostic. Not certified nodata or selection of better score.
statistics: Quality/order means within each scene, scenes within event, events equally. Pixel-count macro includes all3events; recall with zero reference remains null and target-event recall explicitly states2events.
tie_rule: One fixed random cell permutation per order seed; same ranks shared by policies.
timing: Registered after reference composition was known, before any new detector prediction or policy score.
